# Constants (edit everything here)
```{r define-constants}
# Gene set sizes
TOP_N   <- 100  # top genes compared between PG and HVG
LABEL_N <- 20   # genes labeled per category in the plot

# Directories
GENE_DIR <- here("Data_Hold", "Gene_Scores")        # written by Extract_Principal_Genes_and_HVGs.Rmd
CSV_DIR  <- here("Data_Hold", "Dispersion_vs_GPS")  # output CSVs
PLOT_DIR <- here("Dispersion_GPS_Plots")            # output plots

# Plot appearance
FONT_FAMILY     <- "Arial"
LEGEND_POSITION <- c(0, 0)

# Comment out a line to skip that dataset (names must match the extraction Rmd prefixes)
datasets <- c(
    "Human_Intestines"
  , "Mouse_Heart"
  , "PBMCs"
  , "TabulaMuris_Liver"
  , "Azimuth_MMC"
  , "Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex"
  , "TabulaMuris_Lung"
  , "Human_CRC"
  , "PBMC12K"
  , "Pollen"
)

# Datasets whose plot shows a legend (use character(0) for none)
LEGEND_DATASETS <- c(
    "TabulaMuris_Lung"
  , "TabulaMuris_Liver"
  , "Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex"
  , "Human_Intestines"
  , "PBMC12K"
)
```

# Functions
```{r define-functions}
gene_score_path <- function(name) {
  file.path(GENE_DIR, paste0(name, "_gene_scores.csv"))
}

# Read precomputed gene scores; 0 means "dropped / not scored" -> NA
read_gene_scores <- function(name) {
  gs <- read.csv(gene_score_path(name), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  gs$GPS[gs$GPS == 0]                       <- NA
  gs$HVG_Dispersion[gs$HVG_Dispersion == 0] <- NA
  gs
}

# Named vector of non-NA scores, sorted descending
sorted_scores <- function(values, genes) {
  keep <- !is.na(values)
  sort(setNames(values[keep], genes[keep]), decreasing = TRUE)
}

# Same structure compute_scores() used to return
load_scores <- function(gs) {
  list(
    scored_pgs = sorted_scores(gs$GPS,            gs$Gene),
    scored_hvg = sorted_scores(gs$HVG_Dispersion, gs$Gene)
  )
}

# Build the plotting data frame with categories assigned
build_plot_df <- function(scores, all_genes) {
  top_pgs  <- names(head(scores$scored_pgs, TOP_N))
  top_hvgs <- names(head(scores$scored_hvg, TOP_N))

  common_genes   <- intersect(top_pgs, top_hvgs)
  pg_only_genes  <- setdiff(top_pgs, common_genes)
  hvg_only_genes <- setdiff(top_hvgs, common_genes)

  top_common   <- head(common_genes, LABEL_N)
  top_pg_only  <- head(pg_only_genes, LABEL_N)
  top_hvg_only <- head(hvg_only_genes, LABEL_N)

  plot_df <- data.frame(
    genes      = all_genes,
    PPS        = unname(scores$scored_pgs[all_genes]),
    Dispersion = unname(scores$scored_hvg[all_genes]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  # Unscored genes sit on the axes, as in the original figure
  plot_df$PPS[is.na(plot_df$PPS)]               <- 0
  plot_df$Dispersion[is.na(plot_df$Dispersion)] <- 0

  plot_df %>%
    mutate(category = case_when(
      genes %in% top_common   ~ "Both PG & HVG",
      genes %in% top_pg_only  ~ "PG only",
      genes %in% top_hvg_only ~ "HVG only",
      TRUE                    ~ NA_character_
    ))
}

# Table of top PGs with their rank and score in the full HVG list
build_top_pg_table <- function(scores) {
  top_pgs  <- head(scores$scored_pgs, TOP_N)
  hvg_rank <- match(names(top_pgs), names(scores$scored_hvg))  # NA if not scored

  data.frame(
    gene       = names(top_pgs),
    PG_rank    = seq_along(top_pgs),
    PPS        = unname(top_pgs),
    HVG_rank   = hvg_rank,
    Dispersion = unname(scores$scored_hvg[hvg_rank]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Make the PPS vs dispersion plot
make_plot <- function(plot_df, show_legend = FALSE) {
  highlight_df <- plot_df %>% filter(!is.na(category))
  other_df     <- plot_df %>% filter(is.na(category))

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = other_df,
      aes(x = PPS, y = Dispersion),
      color = "grey70", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.6
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = highlight_df,
      aes(x = PPS, y = Dispersion, color = category),
      alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = highlight_df,
      aes(x = PPS, y = Dispersion, label = genes, color = category),
      size = 8 / .pt, family = FONT_FAMILY,
      max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(x = "GPS", y = "Dispersion") +
    scale_color_manual(
      breaks = c("PG only", "HVG only", "Both PG & HVG"),
      values = c(
        "PG only"       = "#1BB7D8",
        "HVG only"      = "#E55B1E",
        "Both PG & HVG" = "#2C9F45"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      legend.position             = if (show_legend) "inside" else "none",
      legend.position.inside      = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.justification.inside = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.box.margin           = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.title                = element_blank(),
      legend.background           = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = NA)
    )
}

# Save plots to PLOT_DIR and CSVs to CSV_DIR, with the dataset name as prefix
save_outputs <- function(name, plot, plot_df, top_pg_table) {
  plot_prefix <- file.path(PLOT_DIR, name)
  csv_prefix  <- file.path(CSV_DIR,  name)

  ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_prefix, "_PPS_Dispersion_Comparison.tif"),
         plot = plot, dpi = 300,
         width = 5, height = 4, units = "in",  # 1500 x 1200 px at 300 dpi
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")

  ggsave(filename = paste0(plot_prefix, "_PPS_Dispersion_Comparison.jpg"),
         plot = plot, dpi = 300,
         width = 5, height = 4, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")

  write.csv(top_pg_table, paste0(csv_prefix, "_top", TOP_N, "_PGs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(plot_df,      paste0(csv_prefix, "_plot_data.csv"),          row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# Run all datasets
```{r run-all}
# Check all gene score files exist before starting
missing <- datasets[!file.exists(gene_score_path(datasets))]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Missing gene score files in ", GENE_DIR, " for: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
       "\nRun Extract_Principal_Genes_and_HVGs.Rmd first.")
}

for (d in c(CSV_DIR, PLOT_DIR)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

results <- character(0)

for (name in datasets) {
  results[name] <- tryCatch({
    gs           <- read_gene_scores(name)
    scores       <- load_scores(gs)
    plot_df      <- build_plot_df(scores, gs$Gene)
    top_pg_table <- build_top_pg_table(scores)
    p            <- make_plot(plot_df, show_legend = name %in% LEGEND_DATASETS)
    print(p)
    save_outputs(name, p, plot_df, top_pg_table)
    "success"
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
}

# Summary
failed <- results[results != "success"]
if (length(failed)) {
  message("Failed datasets:")
  for (n in names(failed)) message("  ", n, ": ", failed[[n]])
} else {
  message("All ", length(results), " datasets completed.")
}
```
